query: I am making a top-up to myself from overseas. How can I set up a Singpass account if I do not have a mobile phone number registered in Singapore?
reference_answer: If you wish to set up a Singpass account for your top-up application but do not have a mobile phone number registered in Singapore, you may contact theSingpass Helpdeskdirectly for assistance.
answer: To set up a Singpass account without a local mobile number, you can use an international SIM card with a local address or register using a work email address instead of a mobile number. [Document 1]
